item.title: ‎Vice President Opoku-Agyemang calls for deeper unity at 14th Dialogue and Peace Iftar Dinner
item.description: By Rachel Quartey & Rukayatu Musah‎‎Vice President Naana Jane Opoku-Agyemang has urged Ghanaians to recommit to peace, tolerance and national unity, warning against attempts to use religion as a tool for division.‎‎She made the call on Thursday at the 14th Dialogue and Peace Iftar Dinner organised by Tudec in partnership with the National Peace Council. item.title: At least 55 Ghanaians killed in Russia-Ukraine war, Minister says
item.description: At least 55 Ghanaians have been killed fighting in the war in Ukraine, with two others currently held as prisoners of war, Ghana’s foreign affairs minister says. item.description: By Nana Karikari, Senior Global Affairs Correspondent Ghana has achieved a rare diplomatic breakthrough in the ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict after Foreign Minister Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa secured personal access to two Ghanaian citizens held as prisoners of war.
